title: Elapsed time versus reward count in released fluorescence

titles: Burke reward-spacing behavioral and dopamine-recording collection

scientific_question: Given distinguishable elapsed-conditioning-time and delivered-reward-count support, do matched held-animal models predict measured cue/reward fluorescence differently after permitted licking and condition covariates are controlled?
primary_outputs: Observed native fluorescence-derived responses provide prediction targets; the scientific answer is the independently recomputed signed loss contrasts and their uncertainty, which may favor time, count, neither, both or non-identifiability. No favored paper conclusion is an answer key.

primary.name: Paired animal-macro held-out AUC-response MSE contrasts for matched M0, ME, MN and MEN
primary.aggregation: Average squared errors within each biological animal and then equally across animals; report Delta=L(MN)-L(ME), G_E=L(MN)-L(MEN), G_N=L(ME)-L(MEN), and both single-axis gains over M0 on identical eligible cases.
primary.rationale: A signed scientific contrast distinguishes better predictive models without rewarding a predetermined sign. Current cue target is the native integral over [cue,cue+0.5s) minus the integral over [cue-0.5s,cue), using observed spans, in stored fluorescence-times-seconds units. The legacy target instead divides each integral by its own observed span and subtracts the means; its MSE cannot be pooled or treated as the same endpoint.

secondary: Each model's absolute animal-macro MSE, complete per-animal/condition results, prediction coverage and stratified/equal-session sensitivities.
Independently tuned MEN sensitivity; raw E/N support, nuisance-conditioned rank/residual diagnostics and practical overlap/precision limits.
Distinct mean-difference and baseline-span-corrected-AUC sensitivities; separately identified consumption, omission and aversive endpoints.
Legacy mean-response MSE, MAE and bias retained in their original stored-fluorescence units only.

comparators.procedure: Published source implements natural-cubic spline/ridge families with dimensions 3/5/7 and penalties 1e-4, 1e-2, 1, 1e2, 1e4, shared inner whole-animal selection for ME/MN and separately tuned MEN sensitivity. Authentic fitting and model-family adequacy remain unqualified.

comparators.name: Legacy five frozen regularized predictors
comparators.inputs: Constant, Z, Z+E, Z+N, Z+E+N on the original cue mean-response panel.
comparators.procedure: Preserve lambda-1, unpenalized-intercept, training-only transforms and animal-equal loss definitions as historical prediction comparisons. Added correlated columns may change nuisance shrinkage, so performance differences are not unique-information estimates.
